title: AI-POLC Data
description: Per-project data shape for AI-POLC (Product Ownership Life Cycle).

po.description: Product-ownership pane for the dashboard PO tab (BUILD_GUIDE §2.1.3). Assembled by AI-DFE into dashboard-data.json projects[].po.

roadmap.description: Now/Next/Later horizons from roadmap.md Epic Horizon Mapping

method.description: delivery method: manual|ai-assisted|ai-driven|hybrid (when set; null/manual otherwise)

blendedMultiplier.description: blended project velocity multiplier vs manual baseline (when an AI method is set)

plannedVsBaseline.description: compression ratio 1 - B/A (planned AI vs manual baseline); null for manual. Distinct from trend (actual, from build engine)

planning.description: Team-domain planning view data (Standard+ depth, derived from epics). Extracted from team-epic-distribution.md and capacity-planning-matrix.md.

utilization.description: Percentage 0-100; null if velocity model absent

capacityFit.description: Overall capacity assessment for the next release (null if velocity model absent)

aiLens.description: AI-LENS fields (AI_LENS_PROTOCOL §6.2 — AI-POLC contract). Present on aiFeature-tagged epics/stories.

aiFeatures.description: AI features identified and tagged during epic decomposition / story elaboration.

aiSubMode.description: Sub-mode from the active palette: opportunity | augmented | native

aiCapability.description: Primary AI capability from the taxonomy (e.g. generation, recommendation)

epicId.description: ID of the epic/story this feature is tagged on

aiAcceptanceCriteria.description: Product-level AI acceptance criteria (quality threshold, confidence, fallback, HITL)

automationLens.description: Automation-LENS fields (AUTOMATION_LENS_PROTOCOL §6.2 — AI-POLC contract). Present on automationFeature-tagged epics/stories.

automationFeatures.description: Automated features identified and tagged during epic decomposition / story elaboration.

automationMode.description: Sub-mode from the active palette: assisted | attended | unattended

automationPattern.description: Primary automation pattern from the §5 taxonomy (e.g. workflow-orchestration, routing-assignment)

automationTrigger.description: Firing mechanism: scheduled | event | manual | continuous

epicId.description: ID of the epic/story this feature is tagged on

automationAcceptanceCriteria.description: Automation acceptance criteria (throughput/SLA, exception handling, human-fallback, straight-through-rate, reversibility)

agenticProfile.description: Agentic intersection-facet fields (AGENTIC_FACET_SPEC section 3 - DERIVED from co-tagged aiFeature+automationFeature at threshold; NOT a lens, no agenticFeatureId, no register). Present on epics/stories where the agentic profile was confirmed; dissolves if either lens tag is removed or drops below threshold.

agenticFeatures.description: Features confirmed agentic (both lens tags at threshold: aiSubMode in {augmented,native} AND automationMode in {attended,unattended}). Threaded by the two existing feature ids.

epicId.description: ID of the epic/story carrying agenticProfile: true

agenticAcceptanceCriteria.description: Agentic acceptance criteria: autonomy scope, tool inventory (intent-level), task-completion definition, escalation path
